verdict.rationale: SavvyCal lists its integration options as a REST API, webhooks, and a JavaScript embed library. The only official library is the JS embed library, which places scheduling links inline or as a popover on a website rather than wrapping the API. Building against the REST API, which uses OAuth and personal access tokens, appears to require hand-rolled HTTP calls. Missing for 10: official API client SDKs in any language, typed or server-side libraries, and a published OpenAPI spec for generating clients (all OpenAPI probe paths returned 404).
